title: Heirloom Sword
description: Awaken a long-forgotten, semi-sentient family heirloom of a vampire, commanding its mystical power as a flying, telekinetic blade.
body:
# Heirloom Sword

![Heirloom Sword](https://github.com/laurinlibossek/heirloom-sword/blob/main/media/next.png?raw=true)

## Overview and Lore
The Heirloom Sword is an ancient, semi-sentient large estoc. It is a long-forgotten family heirloom belonging to a vampire. It has been infused with magical properties, allowing it to function both as a standard melee weapon and as a flying companion controlled through telekinesis.

## Acquisition
* **Crafting:** The item is uncraftable.
* **Loot:** It has a 2.5% chance to generate as loot inside chests found in Ancient Cities.

## Mechanics and Controls
The weapon features two modes (Held and Flying) powered by a mana system.

### Held Mode
In this mode, the weapon functions as a normal sword with a large reach.

* **Warp Step (`V`):** Teleports next to a targeted enemy within 20 blocks. 
  * *Cost:* 10 mana
  * *Cooldown:* 5 seconds

### Flying Mode
Pressing `F` summons the sword into its flying mode. The first summon activates a slow, ceremonial descent, while subsequent summons call the sword quicker. If underground, the sword entity will materialize out of mana.

* **Launch (Left-Click):** Throws the sword in a straight line (max ~70 blocks), damaging and piercing entities in its path. If it hits a solid block, it gets stuck in the block.
* **Recall (`R`):** Recalls the sword mid-flight or after it gets stuck in a block.
* **Charge (Hold Left-Click):** Drains mana to charge a faster, higher-damage launch. Can pin larger enemies to a wall behind them.
![Charged Launch](https://github.com/laurinlibossek/heirloom-sword/blob/main/media/launch.gif?raw=true)

* **Tether Pull (Hold Left-Click while stuck):** Pulls yourself toward the sword.
![Thether Pull](https://github.com/laurinlibossek/heirloom-sword/blob/main/media/tether.gif?raw=true)

* **Guard (`G`):** Sword enters a blocking stance in front of the player, acting as a shield and deflecting physical damage and projectiles. Releasing `G` with an enemy close performs a frontal counter-slash. If mana is depleted while blocking, a guard break lockout occurs.
![Guarding](https://github.com/laurinlibossek/heirloom-sword/blob/main/media/guarding.gif?raw=true)

* **Quick-Fire (`V`):** Fires the sword as a homing projectile at the nearest hostile entity. Also targets players. 
![Homing Launch / Quick Fire](https://github.com/laurinlibossek/heirloom-sword/blob/main/media/quick_fire.gif?raw=true)

* **Sweep (Right-Click):** Spins the sword in front of the player. Moving the crosshair swings the sword to deal contact damage. Releasing right-click flings the sword based on your swing's momentum. (May also be used to mow grass, bamboo, cobwebs, seaweed and vines).
![Sweep](https://github.com/laurinlibossek/heirloom-sword/blob/main/media/sweeping.gif?raw=true)

### Mana System
* **Max Mana:** 100
* **Regeneration:** 0.6 mana per tick (12 per second)
* **Regen Delay:** Spending mana pauses regeneration for 20 ticks (1 second).
* **Lockout:** If mana reaches zero, a 40-tick (2-second) lockout is triggered, during which all telekinetic abilities are disabled.

## Cosmetics and Features
* **Sheathe Command:** The command `/heirloom show` toggles between showing the "sheathed" blade on the player's back.
![Sheathed Sword](https://github.com/laurinlibossek/heirloom-sword/blob/main/media/sheath.png?raw=true)


* **Hidden Features:** There are environmental reactions, idle animations, item-loss protection mechanisms, achievements, and blood mechanics that can be discovered during gameplay.
  
* **Configuration:** Many things may be adjusted to your liking in the config file.
